content: 1. Perform an A1C test for all patients diagnosed with diabetes or presenting with hyperglycemia, defined as a random blood glucose level exceeding 140 mg/dL or an A1C level greater than 7.8 mmol/L, upon hospital admission if no prior A1C test results are available. This test is essential for assessing the patient’s long-term glycemic control and guiding the development of appropriate hospital management strategies. 2. Healthcare facilities should implement standardized protocols to address hyperglycemia emergencies across various hospital settings, including emergency departments, intensive care units (ICUs), general medical wards, obstetrics/gynecology units, dialysis centers, and behavioral health units.
